title: Coquitlam Home Energy Rebates 2026: Heat Pumps, Insulation, Windows and Solar
desc: Coquitlam rebates from BC Hydro, FortisBC and CleanBC in 2026, with housing facts for hillside houses, townhomes and apartment towers.
badge: Heat pumps up to $4,000 for electric-heated homes
lead: Coquitlam has 55,945 households spread across hillside houses, townhomes and the apartment towers around Burquitlam and Town Centre. Which rebate applies depends more on your building type than on your address.
cards_heading: What you can claim in Coquitlam in 2026
cards_intro: Amounts come from the program pages we re-read on October 2, 2026. Each card is a maximum, and most depend on how your home is heated.

cards.title: Whole-home heat pump
cards.note: Must replace electric heat such as baseboards or an electric furnace, meet 100% of the heating load at -5C and be installed by a Home Performance Contractor Network member.

cards.title: Partial heat pump
cards.note: For a heat pump that covers at least half of the heating load while replacing electric heat.

cards.title: Limited-time bonus
cards.note: Extra money on heat pump installs completed between August 1 and October 31, 2026.

cards.title: Income-qualified switch from gas, oil or propane
cards.note: CleanBC pays by income level (Level 3 / Level 2 / Level 1) for a central or three-head heat pump, for invoices from July 6, 2026.

cards.title: Insulation
cards.note: Attic, wall and basement or crawlspace work, paid per R-value added per square foot. Homes heated mainly by electricity only.

cards.title: Windows and doors
cards.note: $100 per opening, with a U-factor of 1.22 or lower.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Only when it replaces an electric water heater.

cards.title: Solar panels
cards.note: $1,000 per kW, capped at half the cost, from an HPCN member installer.

cards.title: Battery storage
cards.note: Up to $1,500 on its own with solar, or up to $5,000 with Peak Saver enrolment.

cards.title: EV charger
cards.note: 50% of a new wall-mounted Level 2 charger, plus $200 for a power-management device.

sections: Three kinds of Coquitlam home, three different answers

A detached house heated by electricity can claim from BC Hydro's Home Renovation Rebates, up to $4,000 for a heat pump and up to $5,500 for insulation. A townhouse can too if it has its own heating and meter. A condo or apartment is excluded from those rebates and has its own BC Hydro program. Roughly 35% of Coquitlam households live in detached houses and about 36% in apartments, so a large share of the city needs the strata route.
Census numbers for the older houses

In 2021, 30% of Coquitlam households lived in homes built before 1981, and 7,305 of them are owner-occupied detached houses. About 69% of households own. A further 4.4% reported needing major repairs. The 1960s and 1970s houses on the slopes are the ones most likely to have low attic insulation and original windows, so insulation and window rebates are the first thing to price after the heating system.
Gas customers and the CleanBC route

Coquitlam is served by BC Hydro for electricity and FortisBC for natural gas. A gas furnace is not covered by BC Hydro's heat pump rebate. Households under the CleanBC income limits can claim $3,500, $7,000 or $13,000 by level for a central or three-head heat pump, and the household of four limits are published in the program document. Above those limits we found no provincial rebate for replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump.
Why the weather barely matters here

The January average low is 0.7°C and the record low in our 2015 to 2024 data is -16.8°C. The heat pump needs to meet the load at -5°C for the BC Hydro rebate, and that is easy for a modern cold-climate model in Coquitlam.

claim_steps: Work out whether you own a house, a townhouse or a strata unit.
If the house is electric, request quotes for heat pump and insulation from HPCN installers.
If it is gas, check CleanBC's income limits.
Ask any installer to put the model number and the heating-load figure in the quote.
Keep the invoice and apply within six months.
faq: I live in a Coquitlam apartment tower. What can I claim?
BC Hydro's home rebates exclude apartments. Ask your strata about the Condo and Apartment Rebate Program.
Often yes, if it has its own meter and heating system and is heated mainly by electricity.
How many Coquitlam households are on the older-house list?
About 7,305 owner-occupied detached houses were built before 1981 in the 2021 Census.
Is there a bonus right now?
Up to $1,000 more on heat pump installs finished by October 31, 2026.
